info.title: SpeechNexus public speech API
info.description:
SpeechNexus public speech protocol.

The OpenAI-compatible subset is limited to the paths, fields, formats, and
events explicitly declared here. A standard OpenAI SDK can use this API by
setting base_url to <deployment>/v1 and supplying any api_key value unless
the deployment enables a shared service key. SpeechNexus enhancements live
under /v1/nexus and the optional `nexus` request field; a standard request
never needs an enhancement wrapper. Unsupported standard parameters are
rejected with 422 `unsupported_parameter`, never silently ignored.

Realtime has two connection modes at GET /v1/realtime: a pre-created
nexus session (`session_id`) and a compatibility transcription session
opened with `model`. Both accept the declared standard transcription
event subset. TTS, previews, metadata, and operation coordination remain
nexus.* events and are available only in a nexus-created session.

get.description:
Lists published revisions in stable profile ID / decimal revision order.
Drafts are excluded. workspace_id is compatibility context, not isolation.
A cursor identifies the last returned profile/revision; pages are live reads.

get.summary: Get one immutable scenario profile revision
get.description:
Public readers may fetch published, retired, or disabled revisions.
Draft revisions are visible only through the administration API.
An existing draft returns 409 profile_not_published; absence returns 404.

get.summary: List published scenario profiles with the active family revision
get.description:
v2 public surface. It reports the same published revisions as v1 and adds
the nullable family default pointer; the v1 ProfileSummary and ProfileList
shapes remain unchanged. Drafts are excluded. Revisions are ordered by
profile ID and decimal revision, and a cursor identifies the last returned
item. Pages are live reads, not a cross-page snapshot. workspace_id is
compatibility context, not isolation.

200.description: Published profile revisions with the nullable family default.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.
Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

External_shared_capability_domains_schem.description: Scenario profiles do not claim the model-binding-only best_effort tier.

External_shared_errors_schema_json_Opera.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.

External_shared_receipts_schema_json_Pub.description: Allowlisted public projection only. Omit content, prompt, instructions, vendor payloads and private runtime identities. Unknown facts go into stable missing/unknown paths, never arbitrary dictionaries.

External_scenario_profile_schema_json_Ro.title: ScenarioProfileRevision
External_scenario_profile_schema_json_Ro.description: Immutable scenario preset revision. A profile composes explicit ASR/TTS policy parameters with capability requirements, validation evidence, and publication lifecycle metadata. It never carries scheduling priority, engine endpoints, model paths, credentials, or user identity.

profile_id.description: Stable profile family identifier. The pair (profile_id, revision) is immutable.

kind.description: duplex profiles are valid only for realtime sessions that reserve both ASR and TTS resources atomically.

required_capabilities.description: Capability requirements. Capability names are unique within a profile revision; producer validation rejects the same capability appearing twice with different constraints.

override_allowlist.description: Only these paths may be overridden by a request. Omitted paths are not overridable even when the value is within a declared range.

override_ranges.description: Allowed override ranges or enum domains. Keys must be a subset of override_allowlist; a range for a non-overridable path is a configuration error. An allowlisted path without an entry is bounded only by ProfileParameters and the binding domain. Producer validation requires minimum <= maximum when both are present.

slo_ref.description: Reference to the deployment SLO document or qualification report scenario. It is not a numeric promise in this schema.

External_shared_profile_parameter_values.description: Must be greater than or equal to preview_interval_ms and is further bounded by the binding, auxiliary capabilities, and workspace policy at admission. JSON Schema cannot express the cross-field comparison; contract tests and runtime validation enforce it.

current_revision.description: Active published family revision; null when no default is active.

XRequestId.description: Validated client request ID or a server-generated correlation ID.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a capacity or cancellation coordination request.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request, invalid JSON, invalid audio, or unknown field.

Unauthorized.description: Shared service credential required or invalid.

Forbidden.description: Origin/Host policy rejected the request or the feature is disabled.

ProfileReadMethodNotAllowed.description: The public profile path accepts GET only.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Backend or capacity unavailable; retry only when `retryable` is true.

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not visible to the requested workspace.

Conflict.description:
Configuration changed, idempotency conflict, operation in progress, or cleanup pending.
operation_in_progress requires error.nexus.operation_id for querying the original
execution. response_not_replayable additionally requires error.nexus.receipt and
never starts another execution. Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}.

SharedServiceKey.description:
Optional deployment-wide shared credential. It grants access to the
shared deployment, not a user identity. When disabled, any Authorization
header value is accepted for SDK compatibility and is not interpreted as
a user.
